purpose: Read-only customer order support backed by WooCommerce through WF-20.
authorization: WF-07 requires order_verified/high_assurance plus a trusted owner scope.
WF-20 is an adapter only and does not grant authorization.
Order ID alone never proves ownership.
privacy: Do not return full billing/shipping addresses, customer IP, user agent, payment tokens, transaction IDs, internal notes, raw meta_data, or other customers data.
Tracking URL is returned only when present in trusted WooCommerce data.
woo_truth: WooCommerce order id/number/status/timestamps/items are transactional truth.
No customer message, screenshot, or LLM claim becomes order truth.
